title: Nimbus (thrive clone) PageSpec
description: The machine contract for a generated page. Closed template enum (33 templates), closed section enum (94 sections), closed mode enum (clone | generation), closed token slots, closed assetRole enum, closed motion object, additionalProperties:false everywhere. Structural rules JSON Schema cannot express live in compatibility/graph.json and are enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py -- a PageSpec is valid only if it passes BOTH.

pageSpecVersion.description: 2.0.0 adds the required mode (clone | generation), the required closed `tokens` slots and the optional `brand` object (required in generation mode).

mode.description: clone = a faithful page of this clone (its own placeholder brand Nimbus/Nova, its copy, its licensed stock and placeholders may be reused). generation = a NEW page for another brand built from this design-repo: schema/semantic_validate.py rejects every source brand, person, customer, screenshot, copy shingle, claim, URL and embed (GENERATION_MODE_* rules) and every asset role whose availability is not generation-safe (assets/asset-roles.json).

route.description: Target path. Each template lists its measured routes; any other path is allowed but flagged (TEMPLATE_ROUTE_MEASURED, warn).

template.description: Closed enum: one entry per distinct page shape (templates/templates.json).

theme.description: nimbus-dark (black body) or nimbus-content (warm near-black body of the content-theme routes); must equal the template's theme (THEME_MATCHES_TEMPLATE). No light mode exists.

tokens.description: Page-level design tokens, each a catalog path of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json. Closed set of slots = tokens/llm/token-policy.json pageSpecTokenSlots. Whether a value is a real, approved, slot-appropriate, theme-valid token is checked by schema/semantic_validate.py (TOKEN_* rules): raw colours, lengths and font names are rejected there.

brand.description: The brand a generation-mode page is built for (required when mode = generation). Never the source brand (GENERATION_MODE_BRAND). In clone mode the chrome renders the clone's own wordmark and this object is optional.

markRole.description: Generation-safe brand mark roles only; the clone's wordmark (brand.wordmark) is clone-only.

motion.description: CLOSED to the real, evidence-grounded motion fields. Values beyond pattern/fallback are optional but, when present, must be values measured for that pattern (MOTION_VALUES_MATCH_PATTERN). No stagger/parallax/scroll-reveal field exists.
